data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 双手捧稳的双层汉堡
data.description: 明亮的快餐店里，阿尔托莉雅穿深蓝针织开衫、白色翻领衬衫和裙装坐在桌旁，双手分别托住双层芝士汉堡的两侧，小心张口咬下一口。她的碧绿眼睛专注地看着汉堡，脸颊微微鼓起，金色盘发上的蓝丝带整齐垂落。桌上是素色纸托盘与一杯饮料，大片窗光照亮她满足的神情。
data.action: 双手托住双层汉堡两侧，微微前倾咬下一口，目光落在食物上。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
data.promptProse: At the fast-food table, Artoria Pendragon supports a double cheeseburger with both hands and leans in for a bite, green eyes following the food. Her dark-blue cardigan, white collared shirt and skirt accompany a blonde braided bun, blue ribbon and upright ahoge. The table-height medium portrait includes a plain paper tray and drink, with the restaurant window beside her. Broad daylight brightens her cheeks and burger, leaving soft shade beneath the tray.
